instruction.name: x86rcr.h
instruction.description: x86-style rotate right through carry on 16-bit values.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain

latencies.notes: rd -> rd chain: the destination is also a source.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: x86rcr.h $r12, $r4; x86rcr.h $r13, $r5; x86rcr.h $r14, $r6; x86rcr.h $r15, $r7; x86rcr.h $r16, $r8; x86rcr.h $r17, $r9; x86rcr.h $r18, $r10; x86rcr.h $r19, $r11
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; x86mtflag $r0, 1
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; x86mtflag $r0, 1' --asm 'x86rcr.h $r12, $r4; x86rcr.h $r13, $r5; x86rcr.h $r14, $r6; x86rcr.h $r15, $r7; x86rcr.h $r16, $r8; x86rcr.h $r17, $r9; x86rcr.h $r18, $r10; x86rcr.h $r19, $r11'

notes: LBT x86-style instruction. rd is both source and destination. Latency is recorded per source operand: the rd accumulator path, the rk path, and the EFLAGS path.
